scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello there~!
How'd you like to
participate in Kafra
Corporation's special
^529DFFBunny Band Event^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您好~！
您想参加卡普拉公司
举办的特别
^529DFF兔耳发圈活动^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Alrighty~
Let me check to
see if you brought
all the items...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
好的~
让我看看
您是否带齐了
所有材料...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Ooh, I'm sorry
but you need to
bring at least
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哎呀，很抱歉，
您至少还需要
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Great, I see that
you've gathered
everything I need to
make the Bunny Band.
Please wait a moment
while I put it together...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
太好了，看来
您已经集齐了
制作兔耳发圈
所需的所有材料。
请稍等，
让我来为您制作...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hm? I'm sorry,
but I actually can't
make this right now. You
need {0}
in order for me to put this
Bunny Band together...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
嗯？很抱歉，
我现在还无法为您制作。
您需要{0}
我才能为您制作兔耳发圈...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Ah, here you go~
The perfect Bunny Band!
Well, I hope you enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
啊，给您~
完美的兔耳发圈！
希望您能喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for
participating in this
special event and your
continued patronage
of the Kafra Services~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
感谢您参加
这次特别活动，
也感谢您一直以来
对卡普拉服务的支持~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hi there~! Would you like
to join our special ^529DFFBunny
Band Event^000000 hosted by the Kafra
Corporation and sponsored by
the Alberta Merchant Guild?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您好~！您想参加
由卡普拉公司主办、
艾尔贝塔商人公会赞助的
特别^529DFF兔耳发圈活动^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Great! Thanks for
participating! If you
haven't already heard,
you need to collect these
items if you want me put a
Bunny Band together for you...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
太好了！
感谢您的参与！
如果您还没听说，
如果您想让我为您制作兔耳发圈，
您需要收集以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
100 Feathers,
1 Four-Leaf Clover,
1 Kitty Band and
1 Pearl. That's it!
Good luck and I'll be
waiting for you here~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
100个羽毛，
1个四叶幸运草，
1个猫耳发圈
和1个珍珠。就是这些！
祝您好运，
我会在这里等您~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
To thank our valued
customers, Kafra Corporation
has prepared a special event
where Kafra Employee will assemble
Bunny Bands for adventurers
who bring the required items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
为了感谢我们的
尊贵顾客，卡普拉公司
准备了一场特别活动，
卡普拉 职员将为
带来所需材料的冒险者
制作兔耳发圈。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
For this special,
one of a kind item,
bring 100 Feathers,
1 Four-Leaf Clover,
1 Kitty Band and
1 Pearl.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
为了这个
独一无二的特别物品，
请带来100个羽毛，
1个四叶幸运草，
1个猫耳发圈
和1个珍珠。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you're ready,
come back and bring
those items to me.
(Sponsored by the
Alberta Merchant Guild).
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当您准备好后，
请带着这些材料
回来找我。
（由艾尔贝塔商人公会赞助）
